# Credit Risk Management Optimization Initiatives

This document highlights critical areas for review and optimization within the Credit & Loans department, focusing on risk management and loan portfolio health.

*   Optimize the default risk standard update process.
*   Review borrower credit scores on a quarterly basis.
*   Review default risk based on audit findings.
*   Optimize the interest rates standard update process.
*   Optimize default risk assessment quarterly.
